versions.changelog: Corrected the tool count and a sentence about who earns what.

Initial release of alter-identity-orderbook.

- Enables posting and managing standing identity trait requirements via an authenticated API key.
- Supports creating, listing, reading, and cancelling your own standing orders.
- Allows polling for priced identity matches as new people opt in and meet order criteria.
- Requires explicit opt-in from individuals before they can be matched or appear in standing orders.
- Includes tools for reading your existing matches and managing standing match pool participation.
